title: 麻将胡了 2 Mobile 游戏卡片背景 OpenAI API 对照候选
intendedUse: 手机大厅麻将胡了 2 游戏卡片的静态竖版背景；界面标题与难度由 H5 绘制
prompt: Create an original portrait 9:16 mobile game-card background based on the supplied 麻将胡了 2 PC portrait art. Preserve its moonlit Chinese palace, jade tiles and luminous golden dragon identity, but compose specifically for a narrow phone card. A majestic golden dragon rises in a graceful spiral through the central vertical scene, with several ivory-and-jade mahjong tiles flying and rotating around its path. Keep the dragon's full silhouette and tile shapes clearly separated; the upward motion should read immediately. Use deep cobalt moonlight, refined gold highlights and a quieter lower 20 percent for app text. Match the PC source's polished dimensional game illustration. No readable text or numbers, logos, watermark, UI, people, currency, photorealism or copied game screenshots.
negativePrompt: wide crop, dragon cropped or hidden, tiles covering the dragon, malformed text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, UI, people, money, photorealism, muddy blue, extreme bloom, clutter

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Match the PC source's golden dragon, moonlit palace, jade tile design and material/lighting style while reimagining it vertically.
